text: scheme_id: pg_indira_gandhi_single_girl_child name: Post Graduate Indira Gandhi Scholarship For Single Girl Child ministry: University Grants Commission (UGC) scheme_type: Scholarship target_groups: Single girl children Girl students admitted to the first year of a regular, full-time Master's degree course tags: girl child single girl child postgraduate master's degree scholarship UGC objective: To support the postgraduate education of single girl children in postgraduate courses only and to recognize the value of observance of the small family norms. benefits: fellowship_amount: amount: 36200 currency: INR frequency: per annum duration: Two years only, i.e. the full duration of a PG course. fresh_scholarships_per_year: 3000 payment_mode: DBT payment_frequency: annual additional_grants: available: False excluded_items: hostel charges medical charges eligibility: fresh_application: citizenship: operator: equals value: India gender: operator: equals value: female single_girl_child_status: operator: required conditions: applicant is the only girl child in the family girl students without any brothers may apply twin daughters/fraternal daughters may apply age: operator: <= years: 30 reference_point: time of admission in the first year of PG course admission: course_level: Master's degree year: first year study_mode: regular attendance: full-time institution_requirement: designated university or post-graduate college institution_location: India course_type: operator: equals value: non-professional institution: recognized: True attendance: regular classes distance_education: operator: not_equals value: True selection: fresh_scholarships_per_year: 3000 verification: Only verified online applications will be considered for the award of scholarship. institution_verification: The host institution where the candidate is studying is required to verify the online application. awardee_conditions: The host institution is required to verify the online application. Institutions where students have taken admission in the first year of PG course are expected not to charge tuition fees to girl students pursuing PG degree courses in Universities/Colleges/Institutions. The institution must submit a progress report after completion of the first year along with the percentage of marks obtained by the candidate. The institution authorities must submit a Funds Utilization Certificate after completion of the first year. renewal: duration: Two years only, i.e. the full duration of a PG course. progress_requirement: A progress report after completion of the first year along with the percentage of marks obtained by the candidate is to be submitted by the institution. funds_utilization_requirement: Institution authorities must submit a Funds Utilization Certificate after completion of the first year. exclusions: Admission to PG course is through Distance education mode. Deemed university does not receive funds from the Central Government or State Government. Family has one son and one daughter; the girl child will not be considered for scholarship under the scheme. application: mode: Online portal: National Scholarship Portal timing: Applications are invited once a year after initiation of the application process and notice published on the UGC website. steps: Candidates fulfilling the eligibility conditions apply online on the National Scholarship Portal after initiation of the application process. The host institution verifies the online application. incomplete_application: accepted: False effect: Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. verification: Only verified online applications will be considered for the award of scholarship. documents_required: submitted_by: student documents: Aadhaar Card Proof of admission into a recognized Master's degree course in an institute located in India and recognized by the UGC Joining report as per Annexure-I Affidavit regarding Single Girl Child status as per Annexure-II Copy of the Bank Passbook Birth Certificate or Class 10th Marksheet submitted_by: institution documents: Progress Report after completion of the first year along with the percentage of marks obtained by the candidate Funds Utilization Certificate after completion of the first year important_notes: An affidavit regarding Single Girl Child status may be uploaded as per the format given in Annexure-II. A joining report as per Annexure-I has to be uploaded. No other additional grant will be payable in lieu of hostel charges and medical charges, etc. The scheme provides 3,000 fresh scholarships every year. The scholarship is paid through DBT on an annual basis. source: source_name: MyScheme official_scheme_authority: University Grants Commission (UGC) source_url:  source_text_provided_by_user: True

Autonomous college degrees are not covered separately; they are included under the affiliating university ranking. exclusions: Professional courses are not covered. Distance-mode education is not covered. Subjects or combinations outside the listed eligible subjects are not covered. Scholarship may be terminated for misconduct. Scholarship may be terminated for unsatisfactory progress, including scoring below 60% in the first year of the Master's program. Candidates later found ineligible may face penal action and refund of the scholarship amount. application: mode: Online frequency: Once a year portal: UGC website / e-SARTS Scholarships-Fellowships steps: Visit the official UGC website. Open the e-SARTS Scholarships-Fellowships section. Select the relevant scheme and click Apply Now. Fill in personal and academic details. Attach the required documents. Submit the application before the deadline. documents_required: Application in the prescribed format Attested copy of university undergraduate degree Matriculation certificate Verification certificate from the institute where the student joined the first year of the PG course Prescribed provisional certificate from the university (not for autonomous college) institution_requirements: Statement of selected students and scholarship receipts Progress report after the first year with percentage of marks Utilization certificate

text: scheme_id: 12 name: Post Graduate Scholarship Scheme for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students-AICTE tags: AICTE GATE GPAT CEED Post Graduate Scholarship details: provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Government of India purpose: Provide postgraduate scholarship support to full-time GATE/CEED qualified students admitted to AICTE-approved postgraduate programs. covered_programs: Master of Engineering (M.E.) Master of Technology (M.Tech.) Master of Design (M.Des.) institution_requirement: AICTE-approved institution/university department and AICTE-approved program. intake_limit: Scholarships are limited to the AICTE-approved intake; an additional 10% may be provided for eligible EWS candidates where applicable. benefits: amount: ₹12,400 per month duration: 24 months or course duration, whichever is lower integrated_dual_degree: Final-year students of dual-degree integrated programs may receive the scholarship from the 9th semester for one year. leave_entitlements: casual_leave: 15 days per academic year medical_leave: Maximum 30 days per academic year maternity_paternity_leave: As per Government of India norms; maximum scholarship duration is not extended. teaching_research_requirement: 8–10 hours per week of teaching/research-related work assigned by the institute. eligibility: Must have a valid GATE/CEED score at the time of admission. Scholarship is subject to the approved intake of the program. Final-year students of eligible dual-degree integrated programs may receive the scholarship from the 9th semester for one year. exclusions: Students receiving financial assistance from another organization cannot receive the AICTE scholarship during the period of such assistance; that period is deducted from the maximum scholarship duration. text: scheme_id: nmmss name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme ministry: Department of School Education & Literacy, Ministry of Education, Government of India scheme_type: Central Sector Scheme target_groups: Economically weaker sections Meritorious students tags: Economically Weaker Section Means-cum-Merit Meritorious Student NMMSS Scholarship objective: To award scholarships to meritorious students from economically weaker sections to reduce dropout after Class VIII and encourage continuation of education at the secondary stage. benefits: annual_amount_inr: 12000 monthly_amount_inr: 1000 fresh_scholarships_per_year: 100000 starting_class: 9 maximum_class: 12 maximum_duration_years: 4 payment_mode: Direct Benefit Transfer bank_account_required: True eligibility: fresh_application: applicant_must_be_student: True parental_income: operator: <= amount_inr_per_year: 350000 source: all sources class_7_marks: general: operator: >= percentage: 55 sc_st: operator: >= percentage: 50 school_type: Government Government-aided Local body student_status: Regular reservation: As per State/UT Government norms selection: conducted_by: Respective State/UT stage: Class VIII tests: name: Mental Ability Test abbreviation: MAT duration_minutes: 90 questions: 90 type: Multiple choice name: Scholastic Aptitude Test abbreviation: SAT duration_minutes: 90 questions: 90 type: Multiple choice subjects: Science Social Studies Mathematics minimum_aggregate: general: 40 sc_st: 32 unit: percentage class_8_marks: general: operator: >= percentage: 55 sc_st: operator: >= percentage: 50 other_requirement: Awardees must satisfy all other eligibility conditions of the scheme. awardee_conditions: Must take up approved courses. No scholarship arrears claim will be entertained after 12 months from the academic session for which the claim was made. If the awardee leaves the course within one month of registration/admission, no scholarship will be paid. In case of serious illness preventing the annual examination, the required medical certificate must be submitted within three months. The student must join the next class/course within three months of declaration of the previous result. A gap of one academic session results in discontinuation.
